I read all of #central-team (you're a member, so it's all stuff you can see) and sent you the list in our DM. I found three Marrow Agrisupply sites:

1. **Eastbank**: Hollis posted on 9 Jun 2026. Ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import, but the file calls the doors E1/E2 while their booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs fixing before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates.
2. **Pine Crossing**: you posted on 9 Jun 2026. The morning receiver can only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to try it with the store login.
3. **Wichita store**: you mentioned it on 2 Jul 2025. This one is a guess. Your Zoom was running the Marrow office hours link at the time, so the "Wichita store dispatcher" was probably Marrow. The message doesn't actually say so.

I left out the Tulsa hub, which is Tansley Parcel, and Door 6, which is Tansleigh Packaging.

The list may be incomplete. The 9 Jun escalation mentions three tracker rows that just said "waiting," but no one named those stores in the channel. No store-by-store list was posted there afterwards either.

I only looked in #central-team, as you asked. I didn't check the shared files or use message search.
